description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for the 'Bank' doctype in ERPNext, including form event handlers, dynamic field updates, and Plaid integration for bank account linking.

classes.name: refreshPlaidLink
classes.description: Class managing Plaid link initialization, script loading, and success/error handling.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Event handler for form load; adds fields to mapping table.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Event handler for form refresh; updates UI elements and Plaid button.

methods.name: add_fields_to_mapping_table
methods.description: Function to populate options for bank transaction fields.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes Plaid link with access token and starts configuration.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches environment and link token, then initializes Plaid.

methods.name: get_link_token_for_update
methods.description: Retrieves Plaid link token via server call.

methods.name: init_plaid
methods.description: Loads Plaid script and sets up link handler.

methods.name: loadScript
methods.description: Dynamically loads external script for Plaid.

methods.name: onScriptLoaded
methods.description: Creates Plaid link handler upon script load.

methods.name: plaid_success
methods.description: Callback for successful Plaid link; shows success alert.
